name: Ride as One
body:
Discipline psychometabolism; Level Psychic warrior 0, tactician 0

MANIFEST

Display Mental

Manifesting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target you and your mount
Duration 1 minute (D)

Power Points psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

While riding your mount you gain the benefits of the Mounted Combat feat.
